body:
Founder caught a real mistake mid-build (relay was Node.js) and corrected it through several real-time messages ending in 'we eat that tech debt' -- server/relay.js deleted entirely. build/edge_relay is now a real, native binary linking genuine PARENA-compiled object code (reflux.prn's REFLUX event log + a new tcp_llvm.prn raw-socket module) through PARENA's new LLVM FFI hatch, plus a thin hand-written C host (server/relay_main.c) for select()/NDJSON. Both cabinet and operator ports now speak plain TCP+NDJSON (HTTP API dropped). New buffered+live-streaming events channel directly answers 'i need you to be able to tell me if the pi booted' -- pi/boot_announce.sh live-verified against the real relay binary. make test-e2e: 12/12 checks pass. Commit f54b68d (local-only repo, no remote configured yet).

⚓ ☃
title: Relay rewritten in native PARENA+C -- Node.js removed, REFLUX events channel added
